title: Vantro Trading: rail is a partial substitute, not a replacement

facts.subject: Orvan wheat
facts.statement: Vantro Trading has shifted part of its Orvan wheat business to the Ravik Rail Link while sea loadings remain disrupted.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vantro Trading has shifted part of its Orvan wheat business to the Ravik Rail Link while sea loadings remain disrupted.

facts.subject: Orvan wheat
facts.statement: The company says the rail link can take only a fraction of the volume that normally leaves Orvan Grain Port by sea.

source_ref.text_snippet: The company says the rail link can take only a fraction of the volume that normally leaves Orvan Grain Port by sea.

facts.subject: Orvan wheat
facts.statement: "Rail is a useful bridge for contracted cargoes, but it will not cover the lost sea volumes," said Samir Tolle, a trader at the firm.

source_ref.text_snippet: "Rail is a useful bridge for contracted cargoes, but it will not cover the lost sea volumes," said Samir Tolle, a trader at the firm.

facts.subject: rail link
facts.statement: The firm has told buyers that any volume moved overland will come with a different delivery schedule and a higher cost.

source_ref.text_snippet: The firm has told buyers that any volume moved overland will come with a different delivery schedule and a higher cost.

facts.subject: prices
facts.statement: The firm expects prices to stay firm while the corridor remains closed.

source_ref.text_snippet: The firm expects prices to stay firm while the corridor remains closed.

entities.name: Vantro Trading
entities.description: A company involved in trading wheat and using rail links for transportation.
